system.name: MoC-System
system.one_liner: a checkpointing system that reduces fault-tolerance overhead for sparse Mixture-of-Experts model training via partial-experts checkpointing

content.subject: how periodic checkpoints accumulate along the iteration timeline and how a fault triggers recovery from the most recent complete checkpoint

relations.what: checkpoints are taken periodically every I_ckpt = 10 iterations
training continues toward a third, incomplete checkpoint when the fault strikes
recovery loads the latest complete checkpoint (ckpt 2) to resume training

panels.differs: ckpt 1 and ckpt 2 complete normally every I_ckpt, a third checkpoint is interrupted (dashed, lost) by the Fault, and recovery reloads ckpt 2 (re-drawn in blue) to resume

content.key_idea: Checkpointing trades periodic save overhead (O_save) for bounded recovery: when a fault strikes before a checkpoint completes, only the progress since the last complete checkpoint (O_lost) is lost, and recovery reloads exactly that last complete checkpoint (O_restart).
content.reading_order: left legend first (Expert/Non-Expert colour key and the Checkpoint parameter/optimizer-state breakdown), then left to right along the iteration timeline: ckpt 1, ckpt 2, the interrupted third checkpoint, the Fault bolt, and the curved recovery arrow back to reloading ckpt 2, with O_save/O_lost/O_restart brackets below

encoding.color_means: tan/orange = Expert-related parameters or optimizer state; blue = Non-Expert-related state; green = a completed checkpoint on the timeline; the reloaded checkpoint is re-drawn in a distinct blue to mark it as the recovery source
encoding.line_style_means: dashed outline marks the interrupted, lost checkpoint attempt; solid outlines mark completed checkpoints; dashed double-headed arrows measure the O_save/O_lost/O_restart spans
encoding.state_means: before (normal periodic checkpointing) vs after (fault and recovery) is told apart by the dashed hollow box for the lost checkpoint and by re-drawing ckpt 2 in blue once it is reloaded
encoding.marker_means: the red lightning bolt marks exactly when the fault occurs; labelled double-headed arrows (O_save, O_lost, O_restart) quantify each phase's duration rather than numbering discrete steps
encoding.emphasis: placing the red Fault bolt directly after the dashed, incomplete third checkpoint, with a curved arrow back to ckpt 2, emphasizes that recovery falls back exactly one checkpoint at the cost of the O_lost span
reusable_patterns: a Gantt-style iteration timeline with periodic checkpoint boxes, a dashed box for a lost/incomplete one, and bracketed spans quantifying save/lost/restart overhead
weaknesses: the small nested Checkpoint breakdown legend on the left reuses the main timeline's colour palette for a different purpose (composition of one checkpoint vs which checkpoint completed), which could be conflated at a glance

summary: This figure illustrates MoC-System's fault-tolerant checkpointing mechanism along an iteration timeline, with a checkpointing interval I_ckpt of 10 iterations. Checkpoints ckpt1 and ckpt2 complete normally, but a fault (red lightning bolt) strikes just after iteration 30, before a third checkpoint finishes, so that in-progress checkpoint is drawn as a dashed, incomplete box representing lost work. Recovery reloads the most recent complete checkpoint, ckpt2 (re-drawn in blue), to resume training. Labelled spans quantify the resulting overheads: O_save for the cost of taking a checkpoint, O_lost for the training progress discarded between ckpt2 and the fault, and O_restart for the cost of reloading and resuming. A small breakdown legend on the left shows what a checkpoint actually contains: mostly optimizer states and parameters, split between Expert (12%/74%) and Non-Expert (2%/12%) portions, motivating why checkpointing sparse MoE models is so much more expensive than dense ones.
summary_zh: 该图展示MoC-System的容错检查点机制：按I_ckpt=10次迭代周期性生成ckpt1、ckpt2，第30次迭代后发生故障（红色闪电），第三个检查点未完成（虚线框表示丢失），恢复时重新加载最近完整的ckpt2（蓝色），并标出O_save、O_lost、O_restart三段开销；左侧图例说明检查点内容按专家/非专家拆分的参数与优化器状态占比。
